resources.string: Lets Dim Tap lock the screen. Only the force-lock policy is used.
Once enabled, tapping the launcher icon turns the screen off immediately. This grant is only used to lock the screen — no wipe, no password, nothing else.
Enabled — tap the icon to turn the screen off
Could not lock the screen. Re-enable device admin in Settings.
Device admin is not available on this device
Without this, tapping the icon can no longer turn the screen off.
Could not turn the screen off
Please screenshot this page, then press Back to close it. If it keeps happening, check that Dim Tap is active under Settings → Device admin apps.
